Group rides in Phoenix, AZ

6 recurring group rides around Phoenix, AZ: 3 road, 2 social, 1 mountain bike. 3 roll on weeknights, 3 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Phoenix Downtempo Ride in Phoenix — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Chandler North Saturday Ride runs a 22+ mph, B 18+ mph, C 15+ mph.
